history.title: History
history.description: Earlier versions of these settings, newest first. Restoring one saves the current state first, so it can be undone the same way.
history.empty: No earlier versions yet. One is kept every time these settings change.
history.unavailable: Could not load the history. Reload the page and try again.
history.changeCount: {count, plural, one {# difference} other {# differences}} from now
history.confirm: Put these settings back the way they were at {date}?
history.restoreFailed: Could not restore that version. It may have been removed - reload and try again.

bin.title: Recycle bin
bin.description: Deleted services, databases and projects stay here for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, then are removed for good.
bin.unavailable: Could not load the recycle bin. Reload the page and try again.
bin.confirmDelete: Delete {name} for good? Its data cannot be brought back.
bin.binRestoreFailed: Could not restore it. Its project may be in the bin too - restore that first.
bin.binDeleteFailed: Could not delete it. Try again in a moment.
bin.daysInvalid: Use a number of days between 1 and 365.

importSite.title: Import a site
importSite.description: Upload a cPanel full-account backup (.tar.gz). Its sites, MySQL databases and domains become a new project.
importSite.wrongType: Choose the backup as a .tar.gz file.
importSite.tooLarge: The backup is larger than 5 GB.
importSite.importing: Importing. You can close this window; the import keeps going and shows here when it ends.
importSite.done: Imported {services, plural, one {# site} other {# sites}}, {databases, plural, one {# database} other {# databases}} and {domains, plural, one {# domain} other {# domains}}.
importSite.unreachable: Could not reach Polaris. Check your connection and try again.
importSite.notAllowed: You cannot create projects in this organization.
importSite.failed: The import did not finish, and what it had made was removed. Try again in a moment.
importSite.busy: Another import is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

warning.noDomains: No domains were found in the backup; add them to the project after the import.
warning.noHome: The backup has no home folder, so no site files were imported.
warning.databaseFailed: The database {name} could not be imported.
warning.folderMissing: The folder of {name} is not in the backup, so it was not imported.
warning.domainTaken: {name} could not be attached; it may already be in use.
warning.notDeploying: {name} was imported but did not start deploying; deploy it from its page.
warning.unknown: Something in the backup could not be carried over.
